description: This PHP source file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationModel class within the OrangeHRM PIM API. The class models the reporting method configuration by serializing properties 'id' and 'name' from the ReportingMethod entity, and implements the Normalizable interface.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationModel
classes.description: A model class used to serialize ReportingMethod entity data (id and name) for API responses within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a ReportingMethod entity and sets the filters for serialization.
